what: Measured records of the Qwen3.8-27B profile (UNIFY_PLAN Schritt 9). The scalar rows were the _QWEN27B_CONSTANTS literals in weg2/form.py (values unchanged); P_CHUNK_BUILTIN was launcher P_CHUNK_BUILTIN_INT8; D_SPEED_* were the literals of weg2/d_reshard _rc9_*_calib. A record holds only for its power limit and (per-stage tables) its P cut.

records.name: P_CHUNK_BUILTIN
records.provenance: the --p-chunk-model builtin-int8 stage lines: a_ms/b_ms_per_1k = pgap_stage_fit.fit_rank_lines over prefixes [0, 32768) of boot weg2rc7c (a54f21cda0, INT8, cut 42/11/11, 512 graph, 1076-1082 device-bound chunks per rank, sd 2.1-2.5 ms), per 512 chunk t = a + b*(prefix+256)/1000; fwd_overhead_ms = PP0 mean #PGAP gpu_gap_ms below 50 ms (3.73, n=2101); eager_floor_ms = xsn422 #PGAP eager host launch 63/42/74 ms
